L1.description: Torras i Bages: Until approximately August 15th, the Palomar/Costat Mar entrance at the Torras i Bages station will be closed due to improvement work. · Catalunya: From 06/07/2026 the connection halls between the L1, L3 and L1, L3 Metro lines at Catalunya, Catalunya station are closed for works.

L2.description: Monumental: Until approximately August 6, one of the escalators that goes up from the platform towards Badalona Pompeu Fabra to the lobby of Monumental station will be out of service for improvement work.

L3.description: Sants Estació: Until approximately August 18th, the escalator that goes up from the lower lobby to the main lobby of Sants Estació station will be out of service for improvement work. · Poble Sec: Until approximately August 27th, due to works, the Teodor Bonaplata access of Poble Sec station is closed.

L4.description: Maragall: Until August 4th, the escalator connecting the lobby and the Trinitat Nova plattform, at Maragall station, out of service due to improvement works.

L5.description: Vall d'Hebron: Until August 16 d'agost, aproximately, the escalator at the Avinguda Jordà access at Vall d'Hebron station, is out of service due to maintenance works. · Plaça de Sants: Until approximately March 27, 2027, the passageway between L1 and L5 at Plaça de Sants station will be closed due to improvement work.
